Problem Statement:
Your task is simple.

You will be given a dictionary of N words . You are playing a game with Kumar. In this game there are Q turns .

On each turn Kumar will give you a string . You have to report an answer .

The answer can be found out as follows:

Take the string given to you , and reverse it. Print the lexicographically smallest string such that the reversed string contains the given string as a prefix. If no such string exists print the string as it is Play the game and return the answer successfully
input_spec:
The first line contains a single integer N denoting the number of strings in your dictionary
The next N lines contains a single string each
The next line contains a single integer Q : the no of turns in the game
The next Q lines contain a single string each
output_spec: Your output must consist of Q lines : one string per line corresponding to the answer for a turn in the game.
